column1: # TAB-separated. Columns: scenario  metric  op  threshold
#   scenario   a scenario id (S00..S27) OR "default" (applies to every scenario
#              that has no own row for that metric)
#   metric     a facts.json observation name -- e.g. http.latency.p99 (ms),
#   op         max  -> observed must be <= threshold (latency, errors, cost)
# The gate applies the "default" rows to every scenario, then lets a scenario's
# own row override the default for that metric. Absolute SLOs catch "too slow /
# too many errors / not enough throughput" outright; the stored baseline (see
# These values are lab defaults -- tune them to your own targets.
# Control endpoint: fast catalog read, should hold a tight tail and real throughput.
# Cache-backed catalog read (S12): should be very fast on a warm cache.
# Deep order-history pagination (S08): allowed a looser tail.
